description: This file defines the StatusResponse class in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, representing a response with status flags and diagnostics information related to some process or entity.

classes.name: StatusResponse
classes.description: An immutable class encapsulating status flags and diagnostics, indicating whether an activity is executing or waiting, with serialization attributes.

methods.name: StatusResponse
methods.description: Constructor setting status flags based on boolean parameters and initializing diagnostics list.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Overrides ToString to provide a formatted textual representation of the status response, including execution wait states and diagnostics.
